text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Vietnamese press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
-- French military chief, General Jean Philippe Povin, has begun an official visit to Vietnam.
-- A fall in the birth rate is causing Vietnam's population to age.
-- The Ho Chi Minh City Prosecutor has called for four death sentences, and prison terms of up to life for defendants involved in the country's biggest corruption case.
-- 40,000 violations of Vietnam's land law have been uncovered during the last three years.
-- Defence Minister Doan Khue arrived in Laos on Tuesday for an official visit at the invitation of Laotian Defence Minister Choummaly Saysone.
-- Vietnam expects to have 1.7 million telephones by the end of 1997.
-- Vietnam's industrial output rose by 12.9 percent in January 1997.
